purpose: Teach: 滑走/注入/征服/履修/標高/図形/代謝/点滴

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、リハビリ滑走路状の歩行訓練を医療チームで設計します
lines.en: Ren, we're designing a staged walking rehabilitation program with the medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady voice with professional reassurance. Slightly slower pace on the medical details. Gentle confidence—no rushed explanations.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬剤の点滴注入は医療チームで慎重におこないます
lines.en: Yes, the medical team will handle all IV medications very carefully.
lines.style: Nod in the voice. Warm but precise. Emphasize 'carefully' with quiet weight. Reassuring without overselling—she's seen this work before.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、依存症征服を支える治療を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're researching supportive treatments that help overcome dependency—it's a team effort.
lines.style: Shift to slightly warmer tone. 'Overcome' gets a lift of hope. Still clinical but less distant. Acknowledge the weight of the work without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学部生の履修指導を、貴院、担当されますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does handle the curriculum guidance for medical students, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet, exploratory tone. Respectful address with a hint of genuine curiosity underneath. Not testing—asking because he wants to understand. Slight upward lift on the question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、標高の高い病院での医療連携を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we coordinate care across different hospital settings—it's all part of how the team works together.
lines.style: Straightforward affirmation. Matter-of-fact but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'together' to underscore the collaborative nature. Steady breathing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 小児の図形認識試験を、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital administers the pediatric cognitive assessments as well, doesn't it?
lines.style: Same respectful curiosity as before. Building on what he's learning. Gentle upward question inflection. He's connecting dots—let it show in the pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、代謝症候群の患者を医療チームで治療します
lines.en: Yes, we treat metabolic syndrome patients with a coordinated team approach.
lines.style: Patient, clear. Slight nod to the clinical competence—she knows this territory well. No hesitation. Calm, steady delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 点滴管理の徹底を、貴院、おこなわれてますね、先生
lines.en: You maintain strict IV management protocols here, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet admiration in the tone. He's impressed by the thoroughness. Gentle, not probing. Almost reflective—thinking aloud with respect. Slight fade on the end.
